[[File:Moderation.svg|thumb|The Moderation card]]
'''Moderation''' was a face card that was a part of the standard [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] deck. It held a value of negative fourteen. The figure upon the card depicted the silhouette of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] wearing their hood down and wielding a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
